morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；sam.pan 中的 /m/ 与 /p/ 都由双唇发音，不涉及词缀变化。

senses.zh_definition: 舢板；一种用于渡人、载物或捕鱼的小船。
senses.en_definition: A small boat used for carrying people or goods, or for fishing.
senses.nuances: 马来语 sampan 的范围不必与英语中典型的中国式平底舢板完全重合。它强调小型船只；是否有帆、船舱或发动机，须看具体船型。[DBP 对相关船只的说明](https://dewanbudaya.jendeladbp.my/2022/06/13/2001/)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penduduk kampung menggunakan sampan untuk menyeberangi sungai dan membawa hasil kebun ke pasar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 村民乘小船渡河，并把农产品运到市场。
dual_scenarios.en: The villagers use small boats to cross the river and take their produce to market.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nak naik sampan kat jeti tu? Pak cik tu dah tunggu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu menaiki sampan di jeti itu? Pak cik itu sudah menunggu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 要去那个码头坐小船吗？那位大叔已经在等了。
dual_scenarios.en: Want to take the boat from that jetty? The uncle is already waiting.
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式。
kat 在这里相当于 di。
口语问句可省略 adakah 和明确的主语。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak naik sampan kat jeti tu? Pak cik tu dah tunggu.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu menaiki sampan di jeti itu? Pak cik itu sudah menunggu.
messages.zh: 要去那个码头坐小船吗？那位大叔已经在等了。
messages.en: Want to take the boat from that jetty? The uncle is already waiting.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak, tapi tunggu kejap. Aku ambil jaket keselamatan dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya mahu, tetapi tunggu sebentar. Saya mengambil jaket keselamatan dahulu.
messages.zh: 要，不过等一下。我先拿救生衣。
messages.en: Yes, but give me a second. I'll get a life jacket first.

etymology.historical_story: Sampan belongs to the shared maritime vocabulary of East and Southeast Asia. Its resemblance to Chinese words associated with three planks provides a memorable connection, but scholars have also proposed an Austronesian origin. The direction of borrowing remains disputed, so the Chinese explanation should be treated as one account rather than settled history. [Linguistic discussion](https://languagelog.ldc.upenn.edu/nll/?p=66278)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sampan 听起来像“三板”：想象几块木板组成一艘舢板。这里只是记忆联想，不代表词源已经定论。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的船只名称，正式报道和日常交谈都适用。称呼年长船夫时，可按关系使用 pak cik 等称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于河流、沿岸、渔村和传统交通等语境。描述具体船只时，应根据实际船型选择 sampan、perahu 或 bot。
